the effect of particulate hexavalent Chromium (Cr(VI)) on homologous recombination repair (HR).
the effect of Cr(VI), one of the most important human lung carcinogens, on the DNA double strand break repair pathway of homologous recombination.
the effect of prolonged Cr(VI)-exposure on HR repair.
